name: Rex
summary: Rex is RoboScience’s full-size wheeled humanoid manipulation robot. It combines a head and torso, articulated arms and a wheeled mobile base for work across indoor spaces. The manufacturer positions the platform for retail, logistics, industrial and household tasks, alongside its Visics embodied model. The public source establishes an announced robot platform; delivery timing and commercial shipment status have not been verified.
